rationale: enter is a shorthand method in the options object literal passed to Traverser.traverse(this.ast, {...}) in source-code.js. Traverser.traverse stores it as this._enter = options.enter (traverser.js:118), and _traverse invokes it as this._enter(node, parent) (traverser.js:137). callback-passed-to-invoker only matches a this./self. reference or .bind( in argument position, which is not this form. dispatch-table-value-registration requires invocation through a computed key, but here the call goes through the fixed property _enter. No in-scope rule covers callbacks carried in an options object and stored on an instance field.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The two fp-novel priors are correct. The callback-passed-to-invoker regression prior over-extends that rule, whose textual discriminator (a this./self. reference or .bind) is absent here.
